name: Luis royo style lora for flux klein 9B
description: Luis Royo Style - FLUX.2 Klein LoRA What does this model do & What is it for? This LoRA brings the iconic dark fantasy, ethereal, and sci-fi aesthetic of the legendary illustrator Luis Royo to the FLUX.2 Klein architecture. It transforms standard concepts into masterful airbrush paintings characterized by melancholic moods, stark contrasts, and highly tactile environments. What is this model good at? Extreme Material Contrast: It excels at juxtaposing rough, weathered materials (rusted iron, rigid leather, heavy furs) with delicate elements (sheer lace, glowing silk, smooth lifelike skin). Chiaroscuro Lighting: Generating dramatic, theatrical lighting with deep midnight shadows and glowing ethereal or stark white highlights. Atmospheric Backgrounds: Producing moody, desaturated environments (fog, ruins, deep space) that make the vivid, rich colors of the main subject pop perfectly. Versatility: While trained on dark fantasy, it beautifully adapts to cyberpunk, post-apocalyptic, and high-fantasy concepts. What is it bad at & How should it NOT be used? Bright, cheerful, or sterile scenes: The LoRA naturally injects a moody, somber, or melancholic undertone. Hyper-realistic modern photography: The model is strongly anchored in a traditional "masterful airbrush painting" style. Trying to force a 50mm camera lens prompt will fight against the LoRA's core training. Flat anime or cartoon styles: It relies heavily on volumetric shadows and realistic anatomy. ⚙️ Optimal Settings & How to Use To get the absolute best results, please respect the exact trigger structures used during the rigorous training phase: LoRA Weight: 0.8 to 1 is the sweet spot. 📝 Example prompt structure to trigger the Lora Opening: A dark fantasy illustration, masterful airbrush painting, chiaroscuro lighting. A muted desaturated color palette with steel blues and greys. Intricate textures of tattered leather and rusted metal contrasting with smooth pale skin, melancholic and solemn atmosphere or A post-apocalyptic sci-fi illustration, masterful airbrush painting, dramatic atmospheric lighting. Highly detailed biomechanical elements, dark cables, intricate metal armor, dark grey and earthy tones or A close-up portrait illustration, traditional painting mixed with soft airbrush. Pale skin, highly detailed eyes and lips, delicate gothic lace, soft glowing light emerging from deep shadows, melancholic expression 📝 Example of a prompt structure to trigger the Lora (edition mode) dark fantasy digital illustration based on the provided input image, masterful airbrush painting style. The main subject features rich colors, slightly muted skin tones, and striking colors that pop brilliantly against the dark environment. Every surface features masterful airbrush painting textures and visible brushwork. The background is transformed into an atmospheric, desaturated wash of deep shadows, cold steel blues, and floating misty vapor. Dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, emphasizing high-contrast glowing highlights on the colorful subject against the pitch-black and midnight blue shadows Edition example: 🛠️ Behind the Scenes This LoRA is highly flexible because it wasn't trained on generic tags. It was trained on 235 manually curated, high-quality images using an uncensored, and custom captioning workflow. Every single image was analyzed by a local Qwen 3.5 27B abliterated Model to extract exact anatomical details, texture vocabulary, and lighting setups Disclaimer: This LoRA inherits the non-commercial license of the base FLUX.2 model. It is created strictly for educational, research, and personal use. Please respect the original artist's legacy and do not use this model to generate commercial products.
